chunks: From him, from ʿAlī, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Ḥalabī and Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar and Abū ʿAbdillāh عليهما السلام, who said:
There is no taslim in the prayer over the deceased.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer; here, specifically the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person over whom the prayer is performed
key_terms.تَسْلِيمٌ: the concluding salutation ending a prayer

ai.seo_question: Is there taslim in the funeral prayer in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the funeral prayer, namely that it does not include taslim. It is a concise juristic narration transmitted from Abū Jaʿfar and Abū ʿAbdillāh عليهما السلام regarding the form of salat over the deceased.
